items.title: 5.13 Viscous drag aur Stokes ka qanoon (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.13 with the viscosity table (PDF 112).

blocks.text: Bahte fluid ki mukhtalif tahon ke darmiyan raghrat ka asar fluid ki viscosity ke zariye bayan hota hai. Viscosity napti hai ke liquid ki ek tah ko doosri tah par phisalne ke liye kitni force chahiye. Woh madde jo aasani se nahi bahte, jaise gaarha taarkol aur shehad, viscosity ke bare coefficients rakhte hain, jo aam taur par Yunani harf eta se zahir hote hain; woh madde jo aasani se bahte hain, jaise pani, viscosity ke chhote coefficients rakhte hain. Chunke liquids aur gases ki viscosity sifr nahi, un mein kisi cheez ko chalane ko force chahiye. Hawa ki thori si viscosity bhi tez raftar car par bari rokne wali force paida karti hai; agar aap tez chalti car ki khirki se haath bahar nikalein to aasani se mehsoos hota hai ke haath ko hawa mein chalane ko khasi force lagani parti hai.

blocks.title: Drag force
blocks.text: Fluid mein chalti cheez rokne wali force mehsoos karti hai jo drag force kehlati hai. Drag force cheez ki speed barhne ke saath barhti hai.

Saadi tareen soorton mein bhi drag force ki theek qeemat nikalna mushkil hai; fluid mein chalte sphere ki soorat albatta bari ahmiyat rakhti hai. Viscosity eta ke fluid mein speed v se aahista chalte radius r ke sphere par drag force F Stokes ke qanoon se milti hai: F = 6 pi eta r v ... (5.28). Magar tez speeds par force aab saada speed ke tanasub mein nahi rehti.

blocks.text: Chimney tab behtareen kaam karti hai jab lambi ho aur hawa ke jhonkon ke samne ho, jo choti par dabao ghatate hain aur dhuan oopar ki taraf dhakelte hain (Do You Know).

blocks.alt: Aatishdan (fireplace) ki aag se eenton ki chimney chhat ke slab se guzar kar oopar uthti hai. Safed dhuan neele teeron ke saath chimney mein oopar jata hai. Hawa ki neeli lakeerein chimney ki choti par se guzarti hain aur oopar se nikalta dhuan un ke saath mur jata hai.
blocks.caption: Do You Know (PDF page 112): Lambi aur hawa ke rukh par chimney behtar kaam karti hai (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Choti par se tez hawa guzarti hai to wahan dabao kam ho jata hai (Bernoulli). Neeche aag ke paas dabao zyada hai, is liye dhuan zor se oopar dhakela jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Viscosity se kya murad hai (short question 5.1)? Sphere ka radius dugna aur speed aadhi ho to us par Stokes drag kis factor se badalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Viscosity fluid ki tahon ke darmiyan andaruni raghrat hai, jo ek tah ko doosri par phisalne ki force se napi jati hai; shehad aur taarkol ke bare, pani ke chhote coefficients eta hain. F = 6 pi eta r v, r v ke tanasub mein hai, to r dugna aur v aadhi karne se drag wahi rehta hai.

items: Viscosity eta: fluid ki tahon ke darmiyan andaruni raghrat (taarkol, shehad bara; pani chhota; hawa 0.019 x 10^-3 N s m^-2). Chalti cheez drag force mehsoos karti hai jo speed se barhti hai. Aahista chalta sphere: Stokes ka qanoon F = 6 pi eta r v (5.28); tez speed par v ke tanasub mein nahi.
